description: Daily snapshot of the size of one Orbit instance's graph. The dispatcher sends one per instance per day.

graph_bytes.description: Bytes on disk of the active parts of the graph node and edge tables, for the active schema version.

entity_counts.description: Live rows per ontology node type, without soft-deleted rows. Keys are ontology node type names, such as `Project`.

^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,63}$.description: Live rows of one node type

projects_indexed.description: Projects under the Orbit-enabled top-level groups whose default branch has a completed code index.

enabled_at.description: Earliest time a top-level group that still has Orbit enabled turned it on, in UTC. Absent when no group has Orbit enabled.

groups_enabled_at.description: Time each top-level group with Orbit enabled turned it on, in UTC. Keys are root namespace IDs. A group that turned Orbit off and on again shows its last enable time.

^[1-9][0-9]{0,18}$.description: Time one top-level group turned Orbit on
